item.title: Vivid Seats $20 Discount for New Customers and Springsteen Releases Minneapolis Performance Video
item.description:
Vivid Seats $20 Discount for New Customers and Springsteen Releases Minneapolis Performance Video

Vivid Seats announced a new promotion for first‑time customers, and Bruce Springsteen released a performance video from his Minneapolis tour opener.

🔖 Offer Details

  • Use code COS20 for $20 off.
  • Discount applies to orders of $200 or more.
  • Available only to first‑time Vivid Seats customers.
  • Code must be entered at checkout.
  • Offer is subject to Vivid Seats terms and conditions.

🎬 Springsteen Video

  • Bruce Springsteen released a performance video of “Purple Rain” from the Minneapolis tour opener.
  • The video features the first full E Street Band performance of “Streets of Minneapolis.”
  • Reported by Eddie Fu.

item.title: Bruce Springsteen Leads All-Star Jam Session to Close Power to the People Fest
item.description:
Bruce Springsteen Leads All-Star Jam Session to Close Power to the People Fest

Bruce Springsteen led an all-star jam session to conclude the Power to the People Fest. The performance served as the closing event for the festival and featured a collaborative set with multiple guest artists.

⚙️ Key details

  • The closing segment consisted of an eight-song set.
  • Performers appeared on stage throughout the duration of the performance.
  • The jam session included a variety of artists from the festival’s lineup.
